style.backgroundSystem: one flat matte painted field per screen, alternating tint so no two adjacent screens share a field: seamless enamel white #F4F2EC for the packshot, pain-point, info card and array screens, pale jade grey-green #C7D3C2 for the claim, scene, comparison and trust screens, and exactly two deep plum-wine #5E2A3E fields on the crust macro and the closing screen; a single hairline field break, no printed landscape, no gradient glow, no vignette, no wooden plank, no bamboo, no linen, no rice paper, no slate, no marble
style.direction: quiet jade-and-enamel Chinese snack detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: pictograms drawn only as flat two-tone filled shapes inside rounded-square chips with one hairline keyline, chip outline in pale champagne #DFC078; section titles sit on a flat plaque with a pale champagne #DFC078 hairline double rule; proof areas are empty chamfer-notched keylines, blank capsules with an empty index well and unlettered square chips; no circles, no seal discs, no numbered dots, no dot grids, no arched frames, no flames or shields
style.lightingSystem: even soft wrap key from the upper left at about 5200K with a large white bounce card on the shadow side, low contrast, one narrow crisp contact shadow under every piece, only a small controlled glint on the crust ridges in the macro screen; never a hard flash, never a dark moody field beyond the two plum-wine screens, never a lacquered sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: quiet jade-and-enamel Chinese snack detail-page system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless enamel white #F4F2EC, pale jade grey-green #C7D3C2, deep plum-wine #5E2A3E and one pale champagne hairline #DFC078; one flat matte painted field per screen with exactly two plum-wine dark fields, no wooden plank, no bamboo, no linen, no rice paper, no slate, no marble, no landscape, no gradient glow; even soft wrap key from the upper left at about 5200K with a large white bounce on the shadow side, low contrast, one narrow contact shadow under every piece; one modern geometric CJK sans set horizontally with wide tracking, headline 28-48pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, plum-wine #5E2A3E lettering on light fields and enamel white #F4F2EC lettering on plum fields; flat two-tone pictograms inside rounded-square chips keyed in #DFC078, section titles on a flat plaque with a #DFC078 hairline double rule, proof areas left as empty chamfer-notched keylines, blank capsules and unlettered square chips; one whole piece beside one cleanly broken half at stable scale, real blistered crust with a dry crumb face and its own pale dusting, never plastic, never glossy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no round seals, no invented facts.
noDrift: no wood, bamboo, linen or rice-paper surfaces
no round seals, dot grids or arched frames
no invented numbers, certifications or efficacy wording
style.presentationRules: one whole piece beside one cleanly broken half is the recurring hero geometry at identical scale across the set; pieces always rest on a surface with a visible contact shadow, never float; crust always reads with real blistered relief, a dry crisp crumb face and its own pale dusting taken from the reference, never plastic, never wet, never glossy wax; the pack stays whole and unclipped in the trust screen and its back panel carries only empty keylined areas
style.surfaceSystem: shallow white enamel tray with a rolled rim #FFFFFF, pale jade ribbed ceramic tile plinth with fine parallel ridges #C7D3C2, matte painted plaster plane in the same jade tint, one handleless pale-jade cup as a scale anchor; no wood board, no cutting board, no cloth, no basket
style.typography: one modern geometric CJK sans only, set horizontally with wide tracking, plum-wine #5E2A3E lettering on light fields and enamel white #F4F2EC lettering on the plum fields; headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen, plus one small tracked latin caption line above the headline as the only secondary type; no serif display, no calligraphy, no brush script, no vertical caption column
